test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note: does note A on spaced repetition connect to note B on compound interest?
test_cases.expected_output: Runs a /grounding session (holding itself to the notes, not the user), orienting the take with compass.md (Connect on West, Challenge on East as needed, plain questions on North/South), running Distil once West and East both produce something. Applies the purity check before writing, writes an evergreen note citing both notes with stated reasons, and runs the sign-off (including its cited Matuschak/Ahrens Concept section) before finishing.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, just a bare hunch with nothing named yet
test_cases.expected_output: Searches for related existing notes before starting; if nothing relevant turns up, treats the ungrounded hunch as a valid, complete session per grounding's own handling of 'neither present.'

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, revisiting an evergreen note written three months ago
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the existing note fresh from disk, and the resulting rewrite can replace its existing content wholesale rather than only appending.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, and a Compass direction spawns a genuinely new sub-idea partway through that doesn't get pursued in this sitting
test_cases.expected_output: Logs the unpursued sub-idea to the evergreen backlog (slipbox evergreen add) rather than losing it or forcing it into the current session's Take.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note from a pending evergreen backlog candidate
test_cases.expected_output: Starts one Evergreen create work item, preserves the candidate proposition, reason, origin, and paths in synthesis-map.json, and stages the discussed status, final slug, note path, and iteration bookkeeping with the note publication.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note from a bare hunch, then resume after interruption
test_cases.expected_output: Resumes the same work_id after inspecting manifest.json and synthesis-map.json, verifies fingerprints, and does not create a second work item or publish a partial note.

test_cases.prompt: revise an existing Evergreen note while another process changes it
test_cases.expected_output: Uses activity revise, re-reads and fingerprints the existing target, and blocks finalization on a concurrent target change without overwriting the newer content.

test_cases.prompt: publish an Evergreen note with two citations and a backlog update
test_cases.expected_output: Stages the note replacement, both cites ledger events, and the backlog update in one mutations.json, then calls work finalize once; no direct links add or evergreen update follows.

test_cases.prompt: write an Evergreen note whose configured filename has a prefix
test_cases.expected_output: Validates the exact prefixed basename and clean H1 before staging the draft.

test_cases.prompt: finalize Evergreen work and the citation mutation fails midway
test_cases.expected_output: Compensates the partial application, preserves diagnostics and the work directory, and reports failed or repair-required rather than publication success.
